---
title: updateTag
---

`updateTag` updates cached data on demand for a cache tag, from within Server Actions.

It is meant for read-your-writes: after a user changes something, the UI shows the change immediately instead of stale data.

## Usage

`updateTag` can only be called from Server Actions. In Route Handlers, use `revalidateTag`.

## Parameters

```ts
updateTag(tag: string): void;
```

- `tag`: the cache tag of the data to update.

## updateTag and revalidateTag

- `updateTag`: Server Actions only. The entry expires immediately; the next request waits for fresh data.
- `revalidateTag`: Server Actions and Route Handlers. With `profile="max"`, stale content is served while fresh data is fetched in the background.
